sentence: This project tries to find out whether sex chromosomes and sex determining genes are linked to how Antarctic notothenioid fish evolved into many species.
This project hosts a conference where researchers share work in applied and computational mathematics, including scientific computing and machine learning.
This project looks for molecules that block deposition in chosen areas of computer chips when switched on by light and studies how they work.
This project studies how hundreds of genes affect pollen function in maize, using imaging and computer vision to measure mutants.
This project tests whether machine learning can make sense of many organic molecules preserved in geological archives to reconstruct ancient wildfires.
This project studies four-dimensional spaces and tries to find out how many stabilizations are needed to tell apart pairs of smooth objects.
This project brings people together at a conference to discuss problems in applied computer security.
This project studies sustainable polymers by looking at how plastics are made, unmade and remade.
This project uses muon spin relaxation and neutron scattering to study how charge and spin interact in unconventional superconductors.
This project connects models of interacting species with evolutionary genetics to study how ecological networks evolve.
This project builds a cybersecurity curriculum and certificate that cover skills for protecting computers and information systems.
This project designs a certificate-based way for drones to prove who they are and keep their communications private.
This project studies how ocean warming below the surface changed over the last 1.5 million years using deep sea sediment cores.
This project acquires an instrument that makes nanoscale patterns by precisely heating a material sensitive to temperature changes.
This project studies how climate change strains water availability in mountain areas and how hydrological, ecological and social systems interact.
This project brings researchers together at a conference on computational photography, including optics, computer vision and sensors.
This project builds hands-on labs and a curriculum that teach how to find and defend against security risks in large language model applications.
This project builds a low-cost wireless system that makes three-dimensional ultrasound images at the bedside to help detect breast cancer.
